title: SBI Bank SO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out 996 Posts
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
fullContentHtml:
Short Information : State Bank of India (SBI) has released the notification for the post of Specialist Officer (Vice President Wealth (SRM), Assistant Vice President Wealth (RM), Customer Relationship Executive). This recruitment has been issued for 996 posts. Online applying process for SBI Bank SO Recruitment 2026 has started from 02 December 2025 & the candidates can apply till 10 January 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

State Bank of India (SBI)

SBI Bank SO Recruitment 2026

Advt No. : CRPD/SCO/2025-26/17

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 02 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 02 December 2025
  • Last Date : 10 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 January 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

SBI Bank SO Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 May 2025
  • VP Wealth (SRM) : 26-42 Years
  • AVP Wealth (RM) : 23-35 Years
  • Customer Rel. Executive : 20-35 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per SBI Bank SO Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

SBI SO 2026 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 996 Posts

Post Name No. of Posts
Vice President Wealth (Senior Relationship Manager) 506
Customer Relationship Executive 284
Assistant Vice President Wealth (Relationship Manager) 206

SBI SO Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Eligibility 
VP Wealth (SRM)
  • Candidates having Graduation Degree in any stream from any recognized University / Institute will be eligible for this recruitment.
  • MBA (Banking/ Finance/ Marketing) with 60% from recognized University or Institution.
  • Certifications such as NISM V-A, XXI-A, CFP /CFA
  • 6 years into sales & marketing with leading Public / Private / Foreign Banks/ Wealth Management Firms / AMCs
Customer Relationship Executive
  • Candidates having Graduation Degree in any stream from any recognized University / Institute with Knowledge of Local Language will be eligible for this recruitment.
  • Weightage will be given to the candidates with post-graduation in finance / marketing / Banking.
  • Certifications such as NISM V-A, XXI-A, CFP/CFA
  • 3 years into sales & marketing with leading Public / Private / Foreign Banks/ Wealth Management Firms/ AMCs /SBI Wealth CREs having 4 years of experience
AVP Wealth (RM)
  • Candidates having Graduation Degree in any stream from any recognized University / Institute will be eligible for this recruitment.

SBI SO Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://bank.sbi/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the SBI before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other SarkariResult2026 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for SBI SO recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Shortlisting
  • Interview
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

Q. What is Age Limit For SBI SO Vacancy 2026?
Answer. The age of the candidates applying for this recruitment as per SBI rules, see the post wise age information in the official information.

Q. What is Qualification For SBI SO Online Form 2026?
Answer. To apply for this recruitment, the candidate must have Graduation pass read the official information completely before applying.

Q. How to Apply For SBI SO Bharti 2026?
Answer. To apply for this recruitment, first of all you have to go to the Official Sarkari Result which is SarkariExam.com and apply through this recruitment page. Through Sarkari Result Official you can apply for many government jobs.

To download your result, you can download it by entering registration number / roll number and DOB (Date of Birth). The official download link of the result will be made available in the important links above.
